summary: Quote on NSE cash: after a full MarketFeedV3 frame, a sparse frame repeating only LastRate keeps the known volume, last quantity and book totals; a later frame with an explicit 0 for one of them replaces that one alone.

notes: The full frame is the web test's FEED (quote_mode's); the sparse and zero frames are the review's input (R107-08, BR-107-02) and one explicit 0 per quantity, worked here. Whether live MarketFeedV3 frames omit quantities is not verified.
Prices are not affected: a missing or 0 price is held on both sides (the average price included).

deviations.reason: 5paisa's MarketFeedV3 frame may repeat only what changed (here LastRate alone); the web reads every quantity it does not repeat as 0 (_quote_fields and _normalize_market_data: feed.get("TotalQty", 0), LastQty, TBidQ, TOffQ, BidQty, OffQty; only prices are held), so it sends invented zeros over the known quantities. The desktop keeps the last known value until 5paisa sends another, an explicit 0 included (review R107-08). Inherited web defect, approved by the lead's review-fixes decision.
